middle-east.name: Middle East
middle-east.description: World-class diving in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf

egypt.name: Egypt
egypt.description: Red Sea mecca: Ras Mohammed, Brothers, and Thistlegorm wreck.
egypt.bestTime: In the Red Sea, June and September offer the calmest seas and clearest water, with temperatures ranging from brisk 17°C to warmer 28°C. Along the Mediterranean coast, similar conditions prevail during June and September, with water warming to 27–28°C.
egypt.bestTimeAuto: From June to September, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 27–28°C in summer and drops to about 18°C in winter. Conditions vary by coast.

red-sea.name: Red Sea
red-sea.description: Legendary for its coral reefs, wrecks, and clear warm waters, spanning Egypt, Sudan, Jordan, Israel, and Saudi Arabia.

eritrea.name: Eritrea
eritrea.bestTime: In May, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 33–34°C in summer and drops to about 27°C in winter.

northern-red-sea-region.name: Northern Red Sea Region
northern-red-sea-region.description: Diving in Northern Red Sea Region.

southern-red-sea-region.name: Southern Red Sea Region
southern-red-sea-region.description: Diving in Southern Red Sea Region.

israel.name: Israel
israel.description: Eilat's easy-access Red Sea diving and vibrant reefs.

jordan.name: Jordan
jordan.description: Aqaba's coral reefs and wrecks at the tip of the Red Sea.
jordan.bestTime: In June, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 27–28°C in summer and drops to about 17°C in winter.

kuwait.name: Kuwait
kuwait.bestTime: From August to September, the sea is calmest and there is the least rain. The water warms to 33–34°C in summer and drops to about 17°C in winter.

oman.name: Oman
oman.description: Fjords, whale sharks, and rich macro life in the Arabian Sea.
oman.bestTime: Dive the Arabian Sea in May or October to November for calmest seas and clearest water; in the Persian Gulf, similar conditions prevail in May and September to October.
oman.bestTimeAuto: From May to June, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 32–33°C in summer and drops to about 24°C in winter. Conditions vary by coast.

al-batinah-north-governorate.name: Al Batinah North Governorate
al-batinah-north-governorate.description: Diving in Al Batinah North Governorate.

qatar.name: Qatar
qatar.bestTime: From January to May, the sea is calmest and the water is clearest. The water warms to 35°C in summer and drops to about 20°C in winter.

saudi-arabia.name: Saudi Arabia
saudi-arabia.description: Untouched Red Sea reefs, liveaboards, and new dive frontiers.
saudi-arabia.bestTime: In the north, April and June to August bring dry spells, while in the south, May offers the calmest seas and clearest water, with warm dives at 32–33°C.
saudi-arabia.bestTimeAuto: From June to August, the water is clearest and there is the least rain. The water warms to 30–31°C in summer and drops to about 24°C in winter. Conditions vary by coast.

uae.name: United Arab Emirates
uae.description: Wrecks, artificial reefs, and warm Persian Gulf waters.

yemen.name: Yemen
yemen.description: Socotra's legendary biodiversity and remote diving.
yemen.bestTime: From March to April, the sea is calmest and the water is clearest. The water is warmest at 30°C and cools to about 25°C.

iran.name: Iran
iran.bestTime: In September, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 33–34°C in summer and drops to about 23°C in winter.

united-arab-emirates.name: United Arab Emirates
united-arab-emirates.bestTime: In September, the sea is calmest, the water is clearest, and there is the least rain. The water warms to 33–34°C in summer and drops to about 23°C in winter.

pakistan.name: Pakistan
pakistan.bestTime: From November to February, the sea is calmest. The water warms to 29–30°C in summer and drops to about 23°C in winter.
